annotations.text:
CORE LOOP
Splash → Play → Game sheet → run → Result. Endless runs: the first mistake ends a run; one rewarded-ad revive per run; run time recorded for Memory Lane and Quick Math only. Each run is saved to local history, then one call records the play and any new best (name chosen once, no Post button). Memory Lane and Quick Math pick Easy / Medium / Hard on the sheet; Rocket Launch and Guess Color ramp up during the run. The in-game bar shows only the game, difficulty (or skill) and score.

ROCKET LAUNCH
One hit ends the run (or shows the revive offer). Score only, no timer.

GUESS COLOR PHASES (by word number)
1–8 four colors · 9–18 six colors · 19–30 shuffled · 31–45 mismatched names · 46+ tinted buttons.

Shown: a mismatched-names word — each name is drawn in another color, with no swatch.

TABS & SETTINGS
Ranks · Play · Profile in the bottom nav, with Play in the middle; Settings from the gear on Play.

Leaderboard names and scores are sample data.

RANKS
One Global Top 10 at a time: pick a game, then a difficulty. The Easy / Medium / Hard row only appears for Memory Lane and Quick Math; Rocket Launch and Guess Color have a single board. There is no "All" view. Each row shows the run time — time shown only for Memory Lane and Quick Math, where ties rank the faster run higher; other games break ties by who scored first. Refreshes once a day and right after your new best (subtitle UPDATED TODAY). When you are outside the Top 10, your own rank is pinned above the nav (YOU · #57 · 420 · 1:31). Opens on the game you last played.

IDENTITY OPTIONS
Chosen: LogicSprint with the double chevron (Option A). It is the name and mark used on every screen and in the app.

Options B–D are kept here for reference only.

RESULT
Quick Math example: CORRECT + TIME. Rocket Launch and Guess Color show CORRECT + BEST instead of TIME (run time only matters for Memory Lane and Quick Math).

NAME ONCE (proposed)
The first synced run opens this sheet over the Result; the name is saved and reused for every later run. Edit it from Profile. Result shows a sync card instead of the old Post card; offline runs sync later.

PROFILE (proposed)
Per difficulty: best, its run time (Memory Lane and Quick Math only) and how often it was played. Rocket Launch and Guess Color show BEST and PLAYED only, and their history rows have no time. HISTORY lists recent runs (BEST tag on records) and is stored on this device only; it scrolls.

GUESS COLOR STAGES (proposed, not built yet)
One artboard per stage, left to right; each stage keeps the rules of the ones before it. Buttons are solid fills (coral, blue, teal, gold) in a 2×2 grid, each at least 88 px tall. One mistake ends the run.

CLASSIC · words 1–5
The switch shows COLOR: tap the color the word is painted in. Four solid colors with matching labels, fixed order.

SCRAMBLED · words 6–12
Same look; positions reshuffle every word.

COUNTDOWN · words 13–20
3.0 s per word, shrinking to 1.0 s; running out = mistake.

RULE SWAP · words 21–30
Some words flip the switch to TEXT (tap what the word says); the switch slides, pulses and fires a haptic, and the button corners switch to Aa. RED painted green → the RED-filled button is correct (teal ring = wireframe marker only).

MISMATCHED LABELS · words 31–40
The fill is the answer — labels are traps. Labels are near-white on a dark chip so they read on every fill. Here: GREEN painted coral → the red-filled button (labeled BLUE).

NEUTRAL + DISTRACTIONS · words 41+
COLOR rule only. Neutral words (TABLE) and shapes (e.g. a blue circle, shown bottom-left of the card) appear only on COLOR turns; slight rotation and a faint pulsing glow ring. Motion respects Reduce Motion; nothing flashes faster than 3×/s.

Rule: COLOR | TEXT switch (chosen). It sits at the top of the word card on every Guess Color board; the active side is lit and the switch pulses when the rule flips. Sample word: RED painted green (COLOR → tap green, TEXT → tap red). Teal ring = correct answer, wireframe marker only.

Run time only for Memory Lane and Quick Math.

RULE · COLOR | TEXT SWITCH (chosen)
Both rules are always visible at the top of the word card, with the active side lit. A change is a visible slide + pulse + haptic, hard to miss. Every answer button echoes the rule in its corner (drop = COLOR, Aa = TEXT).

v1.1 · Hearts, Donate, ads outside gameplay, animated daily Ranks

No free hearts: every finished run unlocks one heart ad. Offline is ad-free.

PLAY
Hearts chip (heart + count) left of the gear opens the Hearts sheet. One shared banner ad, full width, 12 px above the nav on Ranks / Play / Profile; the old centred 320×50 slot is gone.

HEARTS SHEET
No free hearts: new players start with 0, and every finished run unlocks ONE heart ad. Button states: "Watch ad · +1 heart" · "Finish a run to unlock a heart" · "Hearts full" · "No ad available right now". Hearts cap at 5.

DONATE
After one donation the thank-you cools down: the line under the button reads "Next heart thank-you in 24:10" and the button reads "Watch ad to support" until the timer ends.

REVIVE
Offered from score 50 · up to 3 revives per run · auto-ends after 5 s. "Use heart" spends a heart; "Watch ad" gives a life without spending one.

PAUSED
Auto-pauses when you leave the app; resume only on tap. New pause button in the game bar, next to the score. The banner shows only while paused, at the top of the scrim.

RESULT
Every run of every game ends here. Banner at the top, above GAME OVER; Home and Play again stay at the bottom. "Earn a heart" offers the one heart ad this run unlocked.

RANKS · DAILY REVEAL
Rows slide from old to new positions, scores count up, your rank ticks #57→#7 · reduce-motion shows the end state. The climb banner slides in from the top of the list.

RANKS · REFRESH
Daily update is free · Refresh now = rewarded ad, 30 s apart · free fallback every 5 min. Cached view: dates only, no movement chips.

SETTINGS
New SUPPORT group at the top; "Donate a view" opens the Donate screen.

OFFLINE
Offline: no ads, no revive offer (a mistake just ends the run), no banners.
